description: The browser job's image is `v1.63.1-noble` and the lockfile pins 1.63.0 — the two differ in the patch number alone, so a comparison of major and minor would pass it. It is the SECOND mention in the FIRST file, the gates job above it at the right tag: a reader that took one mention per file, or the last file only, would pass it as well. Everything else is the reference.
ciText:
# Playwright's image, mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v<version>-noble, at the lockfile's version.
jobs:
  gates:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble # the tag before the bump: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.0-noble
      options: --user 1001
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected -t lint test build check-browsers
  e2e:
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.1-noble
      options: --user 1001
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
    steps:
      - run: scripts/nx-verdict npx nx affected --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }} -t e2e
